comment: Voicebox runs a local Model Context Protocol server on the user's own machine. This file lives at voicebox.sh/.well-known/mcp.json so AI agents and installer tools can discover how to attach to that local server. The endpoint itself is NOT at voicebox.sh — it's on the user's localhost at http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp after the desktop app is running.

servers.name: voicebox
servers.description: Voicebox local voice server — speak text in cloned voices, transcribe audio, and browse captures/profiles.

tools.name: voicebox.speak
tools.description: Speak text aloud in a cloned or preset voice. Optional personality rewrite.

tools.name: voicebox.transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe audio (base64 or absolute path) using Whisper.

tools.name: voicebox.list_captures
tools.description: List recent audio captures with their transcripts.

tools.name: voicebox.list_profiles
tools.description: List voice profiles available for synthesis.

security.notes: Server rejects requests whose Host header is not in the local allowlist. See VOICEBOX_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
